> [!IMPORTANT] > ### 🍎 macOS: the app will say it is damaged. It is not. > > This build is **not signed** — the Apple Developer Program has not been bought. macOS puts a quarantine flag on anything unsigned that arrives from the internet and refuses to open it, reporting it as *"damaged and
